answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded liquidity vault whose escrow is priced by a trellis of cross-asset risk budgets, so duplicate identities inherit correlated collateral rather than fresh capacity. During a registration gale, truthful auctions clear new keys against the trellis while the vault enforces dynamic escrow, making mass identity. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
